name: dsh-ops-codex
description: Codex adapter for the dsh-ops 0.4.1 native file and document worker.

interface.shortDescription: Native file, search, edit, and document tools
interface.longDescription: Bridges the packaged dsh-ops 0.4.1 one-shot Rust worker to Codex through MCP. It exposes bounded search, reads, edits, file operations, CSV/TSV, DOCX, PDF, and result pagination without FastCtx or a system bash.
defaultPrompt: Search this repository with the dsh-ops native worker.
Inspect these large files with bounded dsh-ops reads.
Verify the dsh-ops Codex worker installation.
